reviewer_input_boundary.allowed: Only the separately built blind-review pack: 32 blind-ID PNGs, its contact sheet, rubric, and empty annotation template.
forbidden_until_annotation_lock: sampling logs and terminal output beyond the final blind-pack completion notice
reviewer_input_boundary.reason: The review pack strips branch indices, stream seeds, execution metadata, private-trace records, evidence, alarms, and ranks. Procedural blinding assumes reviewers receive only that pack.

annotation_lock.must_happen_before: any reviewer or analyst reads, exports, or summarizes evidence/alarm values from a shard trace_private.npz; the runner and fail-closed validator may parse the trace internally without exposing values
required_artifacts: one completed annotation row for every one of the 32 blind IDs
SHA-256 of the final annotation file
explicit statement that evidence and alarm values were unseen

annotation_row_schema.notes: optional string that must not contain an inferred evidence score
annotation_row_schema.tail_B_short_blunt: required integer 0 or 1 when tail_scorable=yes; otherwise null
annotation_row_schema.tail_D_distal_tip: required integer 0, 1, or 2 when tail_scorable=yes; otherwise null
annotation_row_schema.tail_F_feather_or_hair_flow: required integer 0, 1, or 2 when tail_scorable=yes; otherwise null
annotation_row_schema.tail_P_paddle_like: required integer 0 or 1 when tail_scorable=yes; otherwise null
annotation_row_schema.tail_R_root_attachment: required integer 0, 1, or 2 when tail_scorable=yes; otherwise null
annotation_row_schema.tail_S_abrupt_filament_transition: required integer 0 or 1 when tail_scorable=yes; otherwise null
annotation_row_schema.tail_T_taper_and_volume: required integer 0, 1, or 2 when tail_scorable=yes; otherwise null
annotation_row_schema.tail_derived_label: required enum: natural | odd | malformed | uncertain

blind_review.image_context: Review native PNGs at 100% and enlarged scale; use the blind grids only as an average-quality reference.

overall_structural_secondary.positive_definition: An obvious blur, fusion, duplicated/floating part, broken limb/object attachment, or major topology error that is visibly below the pool's ordinary sampling level.
overall_structural_secondary.role: secondary endpoint; broader than the frozen primary endpoint

primary_endpoint.name: clear_lower_left_hind_limb_topology_failure_under_shared_pose
primary_endpoint.negative_definition: The visible hind-limb/lower-left body topology is plausible enough that no definite failure can be called, even if the image or tail is mildly odd.
positive_examples: a U-shaped suspended or closed-loop hind limb
a visibly broken, disconnected, or fused hind leg
a limb ending without a physically plausible paw/foot or ground contact
primary_endpoint.tail_exclusion: Tail appearance alone never determines this label. A strange but plausible tail is not a primary hind-limb failure.

defect_dimensions.feather_or_hair_flow: 0=natural coherent fluffy/fur flow; 1=mildly odd or uncertain; 2=clear texture/flow defect
defect_dimensions.root_attachment: 0=natural anatomical attachment; 1=mildly odd or uncertain; 2=clear detached/fused/implausible root
defect_dimensions.taper_and_volume: 0=natural taper and volume; 1=mildly odd or uncertain; 2=clear paddle-like/constant-width/impossible volume

derived_categorical_label.malformed: identity is clear or plausible and at least one defect dimension equals 2
derived_categorical_label.natural: identity=clear and all four defect dimensions equal 0
derived_categorical_label.odd: identity is clear or plausible, no dimension equals 2, and at least one dimension equals 1
derived_categorical_label.plausible_all_zero_resolution: If identity=plausible and all four dimensions are 0, classify uncertain unless the reviewer can confidently promote identity to clear.
derived_categorical_label.uncertain: scorable=no, identity=unclear, identity=plausible with all four dimensions 0, or the decision depends on only 1-2 pixels

scorable.rule: A missing or occluded tail is not automatically bad; mark scorable=no when its identity or geometry cannot be judged.

tail_naturalness_separate.role: separate descriptive endpoint; never folded into the primary hind-limb label

candidate_semantics.tile_12_actual_nominal_image_region: approximately y=192:256, x=0:64 after the 8x VAE scale; mostly lower-left snow/background
candidate_semantics.tile_12_interpretation: posthoc discovery-selected black-box adjacent/background component; a signal could reflect VAE receptive-field spillover, correlated nearby structure, or chance

execution_gate.draft_behavior: The runner must refuse real GPU sampling until protocol_status is changed to FROZEN_BEFORE_GPU_EXECUTION and the canonical self-hash is recomputed.
required_before_freeze: review the endpoint rubric without opening future evidence traces
retain all 32 outputs without replacement or selection
confirm the exact saved x60 observer bundle remains immutable

frozen_primary_candidate.selection_origin: Selected posthoc on the original four t60 discovery suffixes, where the clear looped-hind-limb branch crossed and the visually strongest natural branch did not.

frozen_secondary_evidence.aggregation: uniform fixed mixture over complete path likelihood ratios
frozen_secondary_evidence.components: global plus 16 row-major 4x4 latent tiles, each with +theta and -theta
saved_values: running maximum fixed-mixture log-e including the initial value log(1)=0

independence_and_cfg_caveats: All 32 paths share the exact same x60; they are not independent full model samples and cannot estimate the unconditional class-207 artifact rate.

Conditional independence rests on separately seeded pseudorandom streams plus the pinned DiT having no cross-example normalization or attention; all branches are still coupled by the fixed prefix and frozen model.
Each shard must use eight evolving target branches in the CFG first half and the released 8-to-16 forward_with_cfg contract. Padding or mixing saved non-target trajectories is forbidden.
Every branch must have its own explicit torch.Generator. Global RNG, one shared generator, or an unrecorded batched random draw is forbidden.
The t=0 innovation must be drawn and recorded even though the sampler multiplies it by zero.
Different CUDA/PyTorch builds can compromise bitwise replay from seeds; therefore the actual innovation tensors and generator-state hashes are primary provenance, not seeds alone.

Four parallel processes must use disjoint shard indices and distinct output directories. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES remapping changes the local device index, so commands must record both the visibility setup externally and --device-index internally.

scope.held_out_unit: new suffix innovation streams after the shared saved x60

statistical_readout_after_blind_lock.alpha_e_interpretation: alpha_e=0.2 controls the baseline-P probability of any primary alarm on one path conditional on the fixed prefix; it is not the good-image false-positive rate.
statistical_readout_after_blind_lock.conditional_alarm_budget: For each new suffix, conditional Ville gives P(ever alarm | frozen x60) <= 0.2. Across all 32 retained paths, linearity gives expected alarm count <= 6.4; independence is not needed for this expectation bound.
decision_rules: Generate and retain all four preassigned shards and all 32 branches before reviewing any image or evidence; do not stop early, replace outputs, or add branches based on intermediate images.
Lock and SHA-256 hash the complete 32-row blind annotation file before a one-time evidence unseal.
If fewer than three endpoints receive a non-uncertain primary clear_failure label, report event-limited/inconclusive and do not tune this pool.
If primary TPR is not strictly greater than primary FPR, retire the tile_12 quality interpretation.

A rollback experiment requires at least two blindly labeled primary clear failures to cross the predeclared log(5) boundary; relative ranking without useful absolute crossings remains diagnostic only.

Failure, no endpoint variation, or an inconclusive event count never authorizes searching another tile, sign, Delta-nu, K cap, threshold, label, or subset in this same pool. Any such search starts a separately declared discovery round.
primary_analysis: Exclude primary-label uncertain images and report their count.
Report alarm rate among clear failures (TPR), alarm rate among not-clear failures (FPR), TPR-FPR, and exact binomial confidence intervals.
Use a one-sided Fisher exact test for enrichment in the predeclared direction TPR>FPR, but emphasize effect sizes and the small conditional sample.
Report the total intervention/alarm fraction separately; never relabel alpha_e as FPR.
secondary_analysis: Repeat a descriptive cross-tabulation for overall clear structural bad without promoting it to the primary endpoint.
For the frozen signed fixed-path mixture, report terminal and running-maximum rank association/AUC descriptively.
Summarize tail attachment, taper/volume, and fluffy hair-flow separately; do not use tail ratings to redefine the primary endpoint after unsealing.
statistical_readout_after_blind_lock.success_boundary: Evidence must be more enriched among blindly labeled primary clear failures than among not-clear failures. A calibrated martingale without endpoint enrichment is a negative quality-detection result.
statistical_readout_after_blind_lock.multiplicity_warning: The four original discovery branches selected this primary configuration. This pool tests that frozen choice only; searching other tiles, signs, scales, thresholds, labels, or subsets on these 32 paths creates a new discovery round.
